answer: Root weight is the square root of escrowed stake, by deposit lineage. A fresh key escrows 400 POA for 6 epochs, weight 20; a plume of a hundred keys funded by one wallet pools 40,000 POA in one root, weight 200. Splitting buys nothing: each island root posts its own escrow for 6 settled epochs; doubling weight costs four times the stake. A tundra of dormant keys accrues no tenure, holds zero weight. A peer audit linking two roots to one funder merges them; one proven fault slashes every bond on the root jointly and burns the holdback. Faking four seals costs quadratic stake no clone can pool.
